about:
Vitality Casegoods Restorations & Furniture Manufacturing Inc., operating as Vitality Furniture, is headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The company was established in 2003 and has since focused on producing high-quality, sustainable furniture for a global clientele. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates as a furniture manufacturer with an integrated event rental division. Its capabilities include custom furniture manufacturing, casegoods restoration, and event furniture rental for large-scale venues. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Vitality serves hotels, restaurants, sport and entertainment venues, commercial properties, and mixed-use developments worldwide. Notable projects include the renovation of the Westin Bonaventure Hotel's lobby, bar, and restaurant; furniture for Super Bowl LVI and the Rams Victory Celebration; and custom pieces for SoFi Stadium and Intuit Dome in Inglewood, California.

The company emphasizes innovative, sustainable designs and a focus on quality and exceptional service to create lasting value for clients. Its founding mission centered on delivering high-quality, sustainable products that elevate every space.
